desc: Derive the finite-field power-sum survival condition for zero-entry variables.
Derive and verify the surviving-walk classification for \(p=2\), \(p=3\), and \(p\ge5\).
Prove the global \((-1)^K\) contribution from all zero-entry variables, including unused ones.
Design the \(O(N^3\log p)\) modular matrix-exponentiation implementation.
Validate the formula and implementation against all public samples.
